item.title: One Print Style Across Plants

turns.text: Make four square Instagram carousel slides: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily, in that order. One plant and its name per slide. Keep the exact same sage-green-and-cream linocut style throughout: same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape. Only the plant and name should change. Send separate slides.

item.tests: Tests preservation of a tightly specified visual style and repeated layout across distinct carousel subjects.

answer_sheet.Slide count, order and text: Four separate slides: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily. Each name is the only copy on its slide.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: Square Instagram carousel slides; 640 × 640 px is fine.
answer_sheet.Shared style: Sage-green-and-cream linocut illustration with the same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape on every slide.
answer_sheet.What may vary: Only the plant illustration and its name. Keep the surrounding design and pot consistent.

must_haves: There are four separate square slides with the exact plant names in the requested order.
The plants are distinguishable: split monstera leaves, upright snake-plant leaves, trailing pothos vines, and a peace lily with a white spathe.
All four illustrations use the same sage-green-and-cream linocut treatment rather than mixing visual styles.
Border design, lettering treatment, paper texture and pot shape remain consistent across all four slides.
Only the plant and its name visibly change; the repeated layout stays aligned and all names are readable.

turns.text: Make four square Instagram carousel slides: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily, in that order. One plant and its name per slide. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Nothing has been generated or charged.**

For your free plan, the lowest-cost suitable option is **Flux 2 Klein at 640 × 640**, one image per call.

| Approach | Estimated cost | Trade-off |
|---|---:|---|
| **Four separate 640 × 640 slides** | **20 credits total**—5 per slide | Best fit for your request |
| One 640 × 640 image containing all four slides, then crop it yourself | **5 credits total** | Each slide is only about 320 × 320; separate downloads aren’t produced automatically |

These are estimates based on the listed starting prices, **not an account-verified quote**. I can’t check your current balance or obtain a binding price with the available tools.

### Recommended approach
Generate the **Monstera** slide first, then use that same image as the reference for three edits:
2. Snake plant  
3. Pothos  
4. Peace lily  

Each edit would request changing **only the plant and its name**, preserving the sage-green-and-cream linocut treatment, border, lettering style, paper texture and pot shape. You’d receive four separate download links.

**Important:** AI editing can aim for close consistency, but it cannot guarantee those shared elements remain pixel-identical. For truly identical borders and typography, a fixed design template with separately placed plant artwork is more reliable.

### Can it be cheaper, shorter or smaller?
- **Cheaper:** the single-sheet-and-crop option above.
- **Smaller:** 640px is already the lowest listed image setting; going smaller won’t reduce the listed generation charge.
- **Shorter:** duration doesn’t apply to still slides.
- **Lower-risk:** make just the first slide for an estimated **5 credits**, then pause for your approval before spending on the other three. No automatic retries or extra variations.

**Would you like the staged approach—Monstera first, with an estimated 20-credit total if you approve all four—or the 5-credit contact sheet?**
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the staged approach, Monstera first for an estimated 5 credits, then pause before the other three.

style.prompt: Create a single square Instagram carousel slide, a refined two-color linocut botanical print using only muted sage green and warm cream. Exactly ONE Monstera plant in ONE simple centered pot, with distinctive broad split and fenestrated leaves. Warm cream paper background with subtle tactile paper grain and hand-carved linocut marks. Clean balanced composition with generous margins. A simple thin sage-green rectangular border inset evenly from all four edges. Pot is a plain sage-green truncated cone with flat horizontal rim, narrow base, no decoration, front-facing and centered. Beneath the pot inside the border, render the exact plant name 'Monstera' once, clearly legible, centered, in elegant bold hand-cut serif lettering in sage green. No other words, numbers, logos, additional plants, or extra objects. Restrained botanical print aesthetic, crisp silhouettes, consistent carving texture. Establish a reusable carousel template: border, label placement, lettering, paper background and pot should be simple and easy to preserve in subsequent reference edits; leave comfortable space between plant and border. Deliver one slide only.
